name: sonar_to_jira_agent
description: Pulls the latest combined findings report for a repo/branch from S3/MinIO and creates Jira tickets.

triggers.name: repo_full_name
triggers.description: GitHub repo to fetch the latest report for, as '{owner}/{repo}' - matches what scanner/export.py stamped on the report

triggers.name: branch
triggers.description: Branch to fetch the latest report for (defaults to 'main')

triggers.name: jira_url
triggers.description: Jira base URL to create tickets in (e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net)
